openings.claim: Speculatively, clearance-rich seating may restore the pointer better than tight fit, including 18 mm substitution. Replace opposed tight-fit contacts with two adjacent plywood datum faces and an insertion stop per rod: end-stop contact, corner seating, hand tightening. A shared plywood cradle uses bolt restraint, elastic seating bias and cord-captive hardware; repeatability depends on seating order, not matched width.
openings.discriminator: Rival: tighter symmetric restraint improves stiffness and return. Datum seating predicts smaller post-exchange displacement despite clearance, including substitution; rival predicts tight-fit superiority. Better return with increased loaded drift leaves repeatability and restraint separately unresolved. Two supplied trials suggest discrimination, not proof.
openings.probe: Use six plywood pieces, eight M5 bolts/nuts, four washers, two loops, cord and permitted hand tools; fabricate within 100 minutes. Cut/drill only plywood; no adhesive, drilling or permanent rod marks; hand assembly/adjustment only. Verify both pockets/hardware fit a 90 mm cube and loosened hardware remains attached. Compare datum-before-tightening against opposed tightening with identical hardware; counterbalance order. Within 20 testing minutes, each configuration gets twelve exchanges (five per original rod, then two 18 mm substitutions) and four 10 N, ten-second load trials. Log stopwatch exchange times, target-card returns, loaded displacement and retention using scale/exchange log. Stop on retention failure: no performance success.
openings.uncertainty: Orientation is unspecified; pocket compatibility, plywood/bolt rigidity and secure unobstructive cord retention require verification. Preload must avoid permanent indentation. Defeat: worse return than rival, escape from the 2 mm target under load, any exchange reaching forty seconds, loose components, or exhausted fabrication/testing time. Insufficient measurement resolution or incomplete trials remain unresolved; stiffness and adequate test time are unproved.

lineage.reason: Preserves relation, rival, split-dependency outcome, declared uncertain fit, constraints, caveats and defeat conditions.

decision: Retain one enabling experiment; deployment and performance success remain unestablished.
